title: App Platform A1 slice 2: booking, email-design and QR modules, CRM files move under modules/crm, check:crm-parity retires
detail: PROG-A1 closed on its probe with the CRM barrel and the import-boundary rule (modules/crm/index.ts, modules/crm/client.ts, eslint.config.mjs). What is left of the A1 scope: the booking, email-design and QR modules get their own barrels under modules/; the CRM files move from components/spaces/crm to modules/crm/components with no import changing outside the barrel; the four CRM route trees keep their paths but share the module, which lets scripts/check-crm-parity.mjs retire. SLICE 2 (2026-10-20): modules/booking, modules/email-design and modules/qr now have index.ts (server) and client.ts barrels, every outside importer uses them, and the ESLint boundary covers all four modules. STILL OPEN: CRM files move under modules/crm/components, and check:crm-parity retires. SLICE 3 (2026-10-20): the CRM files moved from components/spaces/crm to modules/crm/components with no import changing outside the barrel; LIVE-662's probe path and the admin-client baseline path moved with them. check:crm-parity is KEPT, not retired: it guards that the three conversation surfaces call the shared lib/comms modules (ADR-817), which a component boundary does not replace. Closed on the module directories existing.
